mapper.select: SELECT EXPORT_ID, APP_ID, SITE_ID, FOREIGN_TYPE, FOREIGN_ID, FOREIGN_NAME, TYPE, OP_TIME, OP_USER_ID, OP_USER_NAME, OP_ORGAN_ID, OP_ORGAN_NAME, DOWN_COUNT, DOWN_PATH, PRIORITY, STATUS, CREATE_TIME, LAST_TIME, DESCRIPTION, SPARE1, SPARE2 FROM COMM_EXPORT WHERE EXPORT_ID = #{value}

SELECT B.EXPORT_ID, B.APP_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.FOREIGN_TYPE, B.FOREIGN_ID, B.FOREIGN_NAME, B.TYPE, B.OP_TIME, B.OP_USER_ID, B.OP_USER_NAME, B.OP_ORGAN_ID, B.OP_ORGAN_NAME, B.DOWN_COUNT, B.DOWN_PATH, B.PRIORITY, B.STATUS, B.CREATE_TIME, B.LAST_TIME, B.DESCRIPTION, B.SPARE1, B.SPARE2 FROM COMM_EXPORT B WHERE 1=1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM COMM_EXPORT B WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT B.EXPORT_ID, B.APP_ID, B.SITE_ID, B.FOREIGN_TYPE, B.FOREIGN_ID, B.FOREIGN_NAME, B.TYPE, B.OP_TIME, B.OP_USER_ID, B.OP_USER_NAME, B.OP_ORGAN_ID, B.OP_ORGAN_NAME, B.DOWN_COUNT, B.DOWN_PATH, B.PRIORITY, B.STATUS, B.CREATE_TIME, B.LAST_TIME, B.DESCRIPTION, B.SPARE1, B.SPARE2 FROM COMM_EXPORT B WHERE 1=1

SELECT EXPORT_ID, APP_ID, SITE_ID, FOREIGN_TYPE, FOREIGN_ID, FOREIGN_NAME, TYPE, OP_TIME, OP_USER_ID, OP_USER_NAME, OP_ORGAN_ID, OP_ORGAN_NAME, DOWN_COUNT, DOWN_PATH, PRIORITY, STATUS, CREATE_TIME, LAST_TIME, DESCRIPTION, SPARE1, SPARE2 FROM COMM_EXPORT WHERE EXPORT_ID = #{value}

select C.ATTACH_ID, T.NAME, C.RESTYPE_ID, C.ATTACH_PATH from PUBLIC_PEOPLE_RELATION G LEFT JOIN COMM_ATTACH C on C.FOREIGN_ID = G.REF_ID LEFT JOIN TASK_INFO T on T.TASK_ID = G.REF_ID where G.OBJ_ID = #{exportId} and RELATION_TYPE = 'EXPORT'
